title: Provincial Motor Vehicles Amendment V Ordinance 2008

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Motor Vehicles Amendment V Ordinance 2008
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 2008
ORDINANCE V OF 2008
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2008
An Ordinance to amend
the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-I,
17th March, 2008]
No.S.Legis:1(5)/2008, dated 17-3-2008.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:-
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Provincial
Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Substitution of section 112 of the West Pakistan Ordinance, No.XIX of 1965

ORDINANCE V OF 2008
ORDINANCE V OF 2008
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2008
An Ordinance to amend
the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-I,
17th March, 2008]
No.S.Legis:1(5)/2008, dated 17-3-2008.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:-
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
2. Substitution of section 112 of the West
Pakistan Ordinance, No.XIX of 1965.---In the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance,1965, hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, for section 112, the following shall be substituted;-
"112. Whoever contravenes any
provision of this Ordinance, or the rules made thereunder
shall, if no other
penalty is provided for the offence under this Ordinance, be punished with fine
as mentioned in Twelfth Schedule.
"112-A. Unauthorized use of emergency light or a distinctive sign.---Whoever drives a motor vehicle and displays a
revolving or an emergency light, fabricates or counterfeits a distinctive sign
or mark on a motor vehicle in violation of the provisions of this Ordinance,
the rules or a notification issued by Government, shall be punished with fine
as mentioned in Twelfth Schedule and the unauthorized articles shall be
confiscated.".
sections.punishment:
punished with fine
as mentioned in Twelfth Schedule.
